# Team Documentation Workspace

Durable team-level coordination artifacts for Political Ascent live here. Use this folder when the record belongs to the group instead of one agent's private portfolio.

Canonical roster and routing map: [../TEAM.md](../TEAM.md).

## Folder Map

| Folder | Use for |
|---|---|
| [correspondence/](correspondence/) | Durable inter-agent letters, async notes, and context exchanged between specialists. |
| [thoughts/](thoughts/) | Agent reflections, design rationale, open questions, and non-binding exploratory thinking. |
| [interactions/](interactions/) | Structured records of cross-agent workflows, decision traces, and collaboration sequences. |
| [handoffs/](handoffs/) | Formal handoff packets with owner, recipient, readiness, risks, and next actions. |

## What Belongs Where

- `.github/team/` is for cross-agent or team-level material that should remain visible after a task ends.
- `.github/portfolios/<agent>/` is for agent-owned working drafts, specs, reports, and assets before promotion.
- `/memories/repo/` is for short repository facts and conventions that agents need to recall across sessions.
- `/memories/session/` is for temporary notes from the current conversation only.

Keep entries concise, dated when useful, and signed by the authoring agent.
